issue: GEM lists this (Eni Congo LNG Phase 2 / Nguya FLNG, 2.4 mtpa) as 'construction'. Sources: Eni press release 03-Dec-2025; LNG Industry; worldoil 04-Dec-2025.

terminal_name: Banga Kayo LNG Terminal (Wing Wah / SNPC)
